runtime_count_requirement: Independent tracked published-source count must match audited actual Debug app and exact full count label.
query: 回復 チャンス 一時的
app_memory_target: XCUIApplication process; never default current-process metric
setup_per_invocation: exact independently audited full count and learning guide ready
real empty article search visible and focused, keyboard ready, no active filter summary
measured_interval: exact query summary and Agent-loop row visible/hittable, bounded public gestures if needed
termination: Only after measure returns; a later invocation launch may replace process before its own start.
clock_semantics: UI automation/keyboard/gesture/AX synchronization transaction; not pure render or per-keystroke latency.
raw_adoption_gate: Retain exact single-case raw result, all typed rows and arbitrary test-scoped CSV, bind actual context/action; no memory contract or summary statistics before independent raw review.
excluded: SDK/runtime execution in this private task

evidence_identity.source_head_tree: Trusted external workflow context only; not verified from the checked xcresult schema.
evidence_identity.app_package_revision: Trusted external pre-test Debug app audit only; not verified from xcresult.
evidence_identity.result_seal: Canonical path/size/content SHA256 inventory of completed xcresult, written by the external workflow; rechecked before/after raw capture.
evidence_identity.known_common_metadata_reference: Retained adopted Xcode16.4 Clock raw JSON. Reuse only observed common action/device/config/reference fields, never its metric wire contract.
cross_checks: details testRuns device UUID and configurationId
plan configuration and UI test target
external expected UUID/configuration and invocation window when available
evidence_identity.unknown_schema: Do not invent fallback fields. Preserve raw and mark raw-unbound/exit2 when identity shape or external expectations are unavailable.

statuses.raw-unbound-awaiting-binding-review: Incomplete result/context identity; exit2; measurements null.
statuses.raw-associated-awaiting-source-and-metri: Result/device/action/context association only; source identity remains unverified and metric contract unadopted; exit2.
statuses.failed-or-unavailable: Observed contradiction, stale seal/window, failed/skipped/missing test/metric data; exit1.

evidence_identity.Debug_product_build_configuration: Trusted external workflow build flags only; separate from xcresult test-plan configurationId/name.

workflow_registration.first_observation_start_route: Root decides separately; no registration, bypass, dispatch or publication in this task.
workflow_registration.source: Independent v1 review supplied by root; GitHub manual workflow default-branch requirement.
